title: ACAP event payload (either direction)
description: The `data` of a type:event envelope. Optional, never-required discrete notification. MUST NOT carry required state absent from status. Also used for the optional pre-close error frame (name:"error").

name.description: Event name, lowerCamelCase. Open vocabulary; well-known: compacted, subagentSpawned, interrupted, error.

code.description: Numeric code for name:error (mirrors WS close codes).
